node.title: Carga de control
node.summary: Controls introduce costs, constraints and response demands.

relations: Control rationalization can be framed as comparing sufficient configurations, rather than minimizing procedures before stating the objective.
MSCA es una propuesta de evaluación, no una certificación del caso Middle East. Cumplimiento legal y efectos no observados limitan la comparación.
The oversight-threshold study tests whether added review and reconciliation outweigh removed work, rather than treating guardrail count as a measure of debt.
No todos los controles aumentan carga ni la carga necesaria es deuda. La forma en U y el umbral no se presuponen observados.
The rejected turnstile is a field example of why control value must include its effect on the operating flow, alongside the work and risk it removes.
El caso no prueba la curva de carga de oversight ni convierte todo control físico o humano en deuda.
